<b>Compass</b> is a {{CrestSlot|Yellow|1}} in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Usefulness ==
Equipping the Compass will mark [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]]'s location on the [[Map and Quill (Silksong)|Map]]. 

If Hornet does not hold a Map for her current area, her location is still displayed between areas on the [[Areas (Silksong)|zoomed out Map]].

The Tool has no usefulness in combat.

== How to Acquire ==
Bought from [[Shakra]] for {{R|70}}.
